description: This file contains helper functions for socket configuration and connection, including setting socket options and attempting to connect to hosts or addresses.

methods.name: socketHelperConfigure
methods.description: Configures socket options such as binding to interface, disabling SIGPIPE, and cellular routing if supported.

methods.name: socketHelperTryConnectHost
methods.description: Attempts to connect a socket to a specified hostname and port, resolving address info as needed.

methods.name: socketHelperTryConnectAddr
methods.description: Attempts to connect a socket to a specified sockaddr address.
